value.rationale: The Desargues graph is the natural middle-two-level graph of the Boolean five-cube, a well-motivated incidence configuration. Prior literature already studies exactly its scale-two complex, motivating completion at scale three. An S3 conclusion not implied by known scale-two wedge or scale-three facet descriptions identifies a new integral homotopy transition and completes its finite metric persistence, with reproducible structural certificate.
